diagnosticServices.name: Annual/Work Physical
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Comprehensive physical exams for overall wellness, employment clearances, school certifications, and insurance compliance.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Thorough head-to-toe examination reviewing vital signs, organ systems, medical history, and necessary regulatory forms.

diagnosticServices.name: EKG Testing
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Fast, painless 12-lead electrocardiograms to assess heart rhythm, electrical conduction, and detect abnormalities.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Records electrical signals of your heart to quickly evaluate chest pain, irregular palpitations, or pre-operative clearances.
requirements: Avoid heavy lotions on chest before test

diagnosticServices.name: Blood Testing
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Routine and comprehensive blood draws including CBC, lipid panel, metabolic panel, hemoglobin A1C, and thyroid levels.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Convenient on-site clinical phlebotomy with accurate processing for preventative screenings and chronic condition tracking.
requirements: Fasting may be required for glucose and lipid panels (8-12 hours)

diagnosticServices.name: Allergy Testing
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Accurate clinical diagnostics to identify environmental, seasonal, and food sensitivities causing distress.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Identifies specific triggers causing chronic congestion, skin flare-ups, or respiratory symptoms to formulate immunotherapy plans.
requirements: Discontinue antihistamines 5-7 days prior if indicated by doctor

diagnosticServices.name: STD Testing
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Confidential, discreet screenings for HIV, syphilis, hepatitis, chlamydia, gonorrhea, and herpes.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Safe, private testing with prompt communication of results and immediate access to treatment or prevention options.
requirements: Strictly confidential, no special preparation required

diagnosticServices.name: Pre-Operative Exams
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Medical clearances required before scheduled surgical procedures to ensure surgical safety.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Complete clearance protocols combining physical assessment, EKG, required labs, and official surgical clearance documentation.

diagnosticServices.name: ECHO (Echocardiogram)
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Non-invasive high-resolution ultrasound imaging of the heart chambers, valves, and blood pumping strength.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Evaluates cardiac muscle function, heart valve health, wall motion, and detects murmurs or heart failure signs.

diagnosticServices.name: Stress Test
diagnosticServices.shortDesc: Cardiac exercise testing under supervision to evaluate heart response to physical exertion and detect artery blockages.
diagnosticServices.fullDesc: Monitors heart rhythm, blood pressure, and oxygen levels while walking on a treadmill to reveal cardiovascular health under demand.
requirements: Wear running or walking sneakers and comfortable athletic clothes

testimonials.quote: Dr. Prahlad Gadhavi and the team at Newark Medical Associates provide exceptional care. Dr. Gadhavi is very attentive, listens patiently to every concern, and his holistic approach gives me total peace of mind. The staff is always kind, polite, and there is never a long wait.

Dr. Deval Gadhvi is wonderful. She is thorough, professional, and genuinely cares about helping you improve your daily lifestyle alongside medicine. Having primary care, blood work, and physical therapy all in the same location at 337 Bloomfield Ave makes everything so easy.

I had cardiac concerns and was able to see Dr. Sankalp Pathak quickly. The EKG and testing was done right in the clinic with zero hassle. Dr. Pathak explained my results clearly and put together a preventative plan that has me feeling great again.

After my knee injury, Dr. Disha Patel worked with me through dedicated physical therapy sessions. Her encouragement, expertise, and personalized exercises got me back to walking pain-free within weeks. Truly grateful to Newark Medical Associates!
